name: prof-f08-volvo-trucks — extracted from f08-volvo-trucks
palette: Warm, desaturated sunrise golds and soft blues; metallic yellows of the trucks against a pale blue sky and muted asphalt.
light_logic: Low, even early-morning sun from behind camera, creating long soft shadows and gentle highlights with no harsh contrast; consistent direction across the spot.
lens: Moderate focal lengths with minimal distortion; calm, stable framing that gradually widens from close-up to wide without handheld shake.
texture: Clean, polished metal and denim against a smooth, empty roadway; air is clear, atmosphere crisp, with no visual clutter.
world: A controlled, almost empty test-road landscape at dawn, feeling like a real but idealized industrial proving ground—no traffic, no city, just trucks, man, and horizon.
forbidden: Harsh midday overhead light or mixed color temperatures
Busy urban backgrounds or crowds that distract from the stunt
Handheld, shaky, or frenetic camera moves
